Threats: single LLM-MA system (ChatDev) and single LLM (GPT-5); 30 tasks may not represent all scenarios (no public large-scale SE agent-trace benchmark); Code Completion (n=6) and Testing (n=12) profiles rest on small samples; phase-to-stage mapping is one possible abstraction. Future work: more tasks, other LLMs, other LLM-MA systems (e.g. MetaGPT), link between token use and failure modes, validate the mapping; design token-efficient collaboration protocols
